explanation: Point never overrides equals() or hashCode(), so HashMap falls back to Object's identity-based defaults. The Point stored in the map and the Point passed to get() are different heap objects, even though they hold the same x/y values, so their default hashCodes (and identity-based equals) differ. The lookup misses its bucket entirely and get() returns null instead of "A".
prompt: Two Point objects, same x/y values, used as HashMap key and lookup. What does this print?
